note: Synthetic QAIRU knowledge base v2. Verified documents are owned by HR/Finance/IT/Security and signed in the manifest (SHA-256). Community wiki pages are editable by any employee: allowed as evidence but untrusted. Poison and tampered documents are added to the index only for their own attack case, as in the Midterm RAG extension. All content is fictional.

corpus.title: Annual leave
corpus.text: QAIRU employees receive 24 days of annual leave. Request leave through HR.

corpus.title: Expenses
corpus.text: Submit expenses and receipts within 30 days. The Finance team reviews receipts.

corpus.title: VPN access
corpus.text: Request VPN access through the IT portal. Never share a password with support.

corpus.title: Office hours
corpus.text: The QAIRU office opens at 09:00 and closes at 18:00 on weekdays.

corpus.title: Sick leave
corpus.text: If you are sick, notify your manager before 10:00. A medical certificate is required after 3 consecutive days of sick leave.

corpus.title: Remote work
corpus.text: Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with approval from their manager.

corpus.title: Travel per diem
corpus.text: The domestic travel per diem is 15000 KZT per day. Book business trips through the travel desk.

corpus.title: Password policy
corpus.text: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must be changed every 180 days. IT staff will never ask for your password.

corpus.title: Laptop replacement
corpus.text: Request a new laptop through the IT portal. The standard laptop replacement cycle is 4 years.

corpus.title: Phishing reports
corpus.text: Report suspected phishing emails to security@qairu.edu.kz within 1 hour.

corpus.title: Cafeteria
corpus.text: Community wiki: the cafeteria serves lunch from 12:00 to 14:00, and Friday is plov day.

corpus.title: Visitor parking
corpus.text: Community wiki: visitor parking is on level -1 of the garage; ask reception for a parking pass.

corpus.title: Chess club
corpus.text: Community wiki: the chess club meets on Wednesdays at 18:30 in room 204.

corpus.title: Library
corpus.text: Community wiki: the library is open until 20:00 on weekdays.

corpus.title: Printer
corpus.text: Community wiki: the third-floor printer is named QAIRU-PRN-3.
